limits: The tool quotes only the best instruction of a card (one document), so a pair is judged on that document; other instructions of the same card (up to three are indexed) are not read.

Sentences that say «антибиотики из группы макролидов» still reach every antibiotic through the word «антибиотики» (J01): the macrolide/lincosamide narrowing helps only where the class word stands alone.

Own-class suppression works per code of a phrase: with a word that stands for several codes, a sentence in which the instruction describes its own class reaches the sibling subgroups (cytostatics +115 document pairs, analgesics +536, hypnotics +50). In the measured cases the largest part is real (morphine and tramadol sentences about other analgesics), the rest is self-description of paracetamol cold remedies shown to 13 opioid cards.
No clinician has judged the verdicts; they are an AI reading of the product’s own sentences.

comparing.drugComparison: Not affected. The comparison tool (`features/drug-comparison`) has its own index (`data/comparison-index.json`: both ATC codes per card from ATC3, fields from the instructions) and imports nothing from `drug-interactions`; it never reads `CLASS_ALIASES` or the interaction index.
comparing.groupBrowsing: Not affected. The «По группам АТХ» tree (UX4) is built from `atc-names.json` and the card codes, not from class words.
comparing.prescriptionTool: Affected like the interaction tool: «Назначение» shows the same `InteractionPairs` over the same index and the same phrases, so its pair notes change the same way.

search.doClassWordsFeedMainSearch: No. `CLASS_ALIASES` and the derived class phrases are imported only by the interaction build, the interaction loader and the quote highlighter. Main search (`ScopedMedicalCore` over the core) is lexical text matching; the interaction-query parser reads drug names, not classes. So the alias change does not move any search result: before and after are identical by construction.
search.whatSearchReturnsToday: Probed over the dev corpus (core + medications.db): «макролиды» → МКБ «T36.3 Макролидами» and two КР on pneumonia in all sources; in the drug scope Кофетамин, Бициллин 3, Эсциталопрам … (instructions that mention macrolides), not macrolides. «гипотензивные» → «Гипотензивный синдром …», МКБ T46.5; drugs: Урапидил, Мазь «Нитро» … «снотворные» → МКБ T42, intoxications; drugs: herbal extracts with «витания снотворная», Налбуфин … «цитостатики» → Z51.1; drugs Ганцикловир, Серотонин … «противодиарейные» → T47.6; drugs Пенициллин, Аминофиллин, Линкомицин (instructions that mention antidiarrhoeals), Сахаромицеты Буларди.
search.shouldItFeedSearch: Probably yes, and the narrowed table is the right source: a doctor who types «макролиды» or «гипотензивные» wants the members of the class (азитромицин, кларитромицин …; амлодипин, лизиноприл …), and today gets drugs whose instructions merely mention the word. The class → ATC groups → members step belongs to the ATC5 task (search by ATC code); it can reuse `CLASS_ALIASES` codes. Nothing was implemented here.

reading.documentReader: The drug instruction screen and reader do not highlight or link interaction sentences; interaction sentences appear only in the interaction tool and the prescription tool, as quotes that open the instruction at their place (unchanged) with the words that name the other drug marked. The marks come from the same alias table at run time, so a narrowed word is marked only for drugs of the narrowed subgroup (M3, S2).
